name: Cover
desc: Cover makes a target harder to harm. Half cover (e.g. a low wall or another creature) grants a +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. Three-quarters cover (e.g. an arrow slit or thick tree trunk) grants a +5 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. A target with total cover can't be targeted directly by an attack or a spell, though some area-effect spells can reach it. A target benefits only from the most protective degree of cover available.
